title: Israel kills Iranian nuclear scientists first

tellings.quote: Who were the first people the Israelis killed in Iran when they went in?

plain: A researcher and commentator named Eric Weinstein, speaking with a Pentagon scientist on podcast host Jesse Michels's show in 2026, asks who the first people were that the Israelis killed when they went into Iran, pointing to Iran's nuclear scientists. He raises it to suggest that scientists in sensitive fields are targets, which, if true, would be one reason secret research stays secret.
